evidence_snippets: Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) organization policies Cloud SQL supports two organization policy constraints that help ensure CMEK protection across an organization: constraints/gcp.restrictNonCmekServices and constraints/gcp.restrictCmekCryptoKeyProjects .
For information about CMEK organization policy constraints, see Organization policy constraints .

evidence_snippets: You can use organizational policy constraints to enforce data residency requirements at the organization, project, or folder level.
CMEK are intended for organizations that have sensitive or regulated data that requires them to manage their own encryption keys.
These constraints let you define the Google Cloud locations where users can create resources for supported services.
